title: SEC championship game comes to an end after 35 years
text:
SEC championship game comes to end after 35 years Schedule Football Basketball Baseball Recruiting SEC Sports Newsletter FOOTBALL SEC championship game comes to an end after 35 years
 Austin Butler UGA Wire Updated Nov. 10, 2026, 10:27 p.m. ET One of the historic runs in college sports will come to an end in college football when the final SEC championship game is played this season. From 1992 through 2025, the SEC championship game brought many memorable contests and it will have one more chance to do so in 2026.
 The Southeastern Conference announced the decision on Monday following the announcement the College Football Playoff would adopt a 24-team format in 2027.
 The SEC championship game was first played on Dec. 5, 1992, at Legion Field in Birmingham, Alabama. Alabama was crowned the SEC champion by defeating Florida 28-21.
 After Year 2, the game was moved to the Georgia Dome in Atlanta, where it remained for 23 seasons until the facility was demolished in 2016, Since year 2017, SEC championship games have been played at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.
 In honor of the SEC championship games , let's take a quick glance at four memorable SEC championship games that involve the Georgia Bulldogs .
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. 2012: Alabama 32, Georgia 28
 This was one of the best SEC championship games in all of its years. It was also one of the best Georgia-Alabama games in recent memory. This game decided which team would face Notre Dame in the national championship game. The game went back and forth with both teams' offenses and defenses making big plays. The game came down to the final possession: Georgia drove deep into Alabama territory but the Tide held on.
 2018: Alabama 35, Georgia 28
 This game was as intense as they get. Georgia made multiple plays to put itself in position to win, but Alabama had an answer each time. Alabama backup quarterback Jalen Hurts came off the bench in the fourth quarter after Tua Tagovailoa was injured. Hurts led a big comeback. Among his late-game highlights were the game-tying touchdown pass and the go-ahead touchdown run. The latter came with just over a minute left.
 2024: Georgia 22, Texas 19 (OT)
 This game was similar to the 2018 SEC championship game but this time in Georgia's favor. Backup quarterback Gunner Stockton took over the offense after starting quarterback Carson Beck was injured. Georgia played a tough game, and Trevor Etienne scored the game-winning touchdown in the first overtime period to give the Bulldogs the 22-19 win.
 2025: Georgia 28, Alabama 7
 This matchup always speaks for itself. Georgia dominated Alabama in all facets, giving coach Kirby Smart and the Georgia Bulldogs their first SEC championship game victory over the Alabama Crimson Tide . Georgia quarterback Gunner Stockton threw for three touchdowns as Georgia won back-to-back SEC titles.
 For Georgia fans across the country, 2026 would be a special year to not just compete in the SEC championship game but to win it. Georgia would close this historic chapter by being the last team to win the SEC title and by winning the last three championship games.
 The SEC championship game will be missed by college football fans. However, every era must end, and those great memories will live on.
